intro: Tourism is the backbone of Antigua and Barbuda's economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Beaches, sailing and luxury resorts bring visitors. Antigua Sailing Week is one of the Caribbean's top regattas.

chapters.title: Finance
text: Offshore finance and citizenship by investment add income.
